notes.title: Am I dead?
notes.content:
ːBlueStrainː [h1]Hello folks![/h1] ːGreenStrainː

This last month was crazy and I was really busy! As some of you know, I am a music teacher and when December knocks at our doors, it means Christmas Shows! So I had lot of works to do and I had to take a break from developping Cellz a bit...

With that being said, there is no need to be worried, I'm not dead at all! And I have tons of great ideas to put in Cellz to make the game freeze your brain this winter! Stay tuned!

Mathieu

notes.title: Cellz Steam Cards!
notes.content:
[b]Good news everyone![/b]

Cellz's Steam Cards were approved by Steam and will soonly appear in your inventory! As I said in the previous post, you simply need to play 30 minutes to unlock one. Oh yeah, and don't forget to collect the badges! When you unlock all the cards, you can exchange them to receive a marvellous new badge.

And look at these emoticons :D 
[spoiler]ːBobbyFishː ːCellzː ːGreaseParticleː ːMonocyteː ːPlateletː ːRedCellzː [/spoiler]

[h1][b][u]More good news![/u][/b][/h1]

[b]First update is coming soon![/b]

Cellz SV-0.02 will be available to download soon. I plan to release it on 14 November. It will cover Resolutions and display issues (thanks to [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCmapT4wn1NHk6XSnuCYDb-w]Lolipoi Gaming[/url]) and will also contain some great surprises!

[b]First MacOS build![/b]

I really want Cellz to have a bigger community around it, so I decided to build and test a Mac version of Cellz. I must be honest, I only have an old macbook to test it... But anyway, it still is one of my priority!

Thank you everyone for your patience! I am still working very hard and every day for you!

Take care,
Mathieu

notes.title: Steam Cards coming soon
notes.content:
[h1]Upcoming Steam trading cards![/h1]

Hey fellas! 

Cellz cards will appear soon in your inventories!

One of my primary goal is to implement the most of Steam in my game, so I created 5 Cards and all the badges! I am waiting for Steam's approval and then we'll be ready to go!
